name: The Graph
tagline: Decentralized indexing protocol for querying blockchain data via GraphQL
description: The Graph is a decentralized protocol for indexing and querying blockchain data. Developers deploy or query subgraphs—open GraphQL APIs over Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum, and many other networks—using hosted gateways or the decentralized network. Common use cases include on-chain balances, NFT metadata, DeFi protocol state, and historical event streams without running your own indexer.

auth.details: API key in path or query for Gateway queries (e.g. https://gateway.thegraph.com/api/[api-key]/subgraphs/id/[subgraph-id]); keys created in Subgraph Studio

use_cases: query indexed Ethereum smart contract events via GraphQL
fetch NFT collection metadata and transfer history from a subgraph
get DeFi protocol TVL and pool state from published subgraphs
stream historical on-chain activity without running a full node
look up token balances and transfers across supported chains
